name: João Pinto

sources.excerpt: Senior career: 1988–1989 Boavista; 1990–1991 Atlético Madrileño; 1991–1992 Boavista; 1992–2000 Benfica; 2000–2004 Sporting CP; 2004–2006 Boavista; 2006–2008 Braga.

João Pinto came through the youth system at Boavista FC, making his league debut at the age of 17 in 1989 before moving to Club Atlético de Madrid for one fruitless season in 1990. He returned for two further campaigns at Boavista before joining Benfica in 1992. He stayed with Benfica until 2000 before joining Sporting. João Pinto then returned to Boavista in 2004, and to SC Braga two seasons later.
